p: wilderness and the solitary place shall: He prophecies of the full restoration of the Church both of the Jews and Gentiles under Christ, which will be fully accomplished at the last day: although as yet it is compared to a desert and wilderness.
Carmel and Sharon: The Church which was before compared to a barren wilderness will by Christ be made most plenteous and beautiful.
see the glory of the LORD: He shows that the presence of God is the reason that the Church brings forth fruit and flourishes.
Strengthen ye the weak hands: He wills all to encourage one another, and especially the ministers to exhort and strengthen the weak, that they may patiently abide the coming of God, which is at hand.
blind shall be opened: When the knowledge of Christ is revealed.
wilderness shall waters break out: They who were barren and destitute of the graces of God, will have them given by Christ.
holiness: It will be for the saints of God and not for the wicked.
shall be for those: God will lead and guide them, alluding to the bringing forth of Egypt.
ravenous beast shall go up on: As he threatens the wicked with destruction by this, Isa 30:6.
ransomed of the LORD shall return: Whom the Lord will deliver from the captivity of Babylon.
